rationale: The prior plan grouped claims only by the combined dimension (provider_specialty+network_status), but the task objective requires comparisons across provider specialties and network status separately as well. The failed checks for missing group_comparison.groups.network_status and group_comparison.groups.provider_specialty indicate these individual groupings were required. The revised plan expands the group_by parameter to include all three perspectives: provider_specialty alone, network_status alone, and their combination. This produces the complete set of required metrics—claim counts, paid amounts, denial rates over adjudicated claims (per the denial_rate_denominator_standardization skill), fraud rates, and small-group flags at min_group_size=30—addressing all failed correctness checks. The synthetic_data and small_groups caveats remain in the report per the evolved skills.
changes_summary: Expanded group_comparison group_by parameter from ['provider_specialty+network_status'] to ['provider_specialty', 'network_status', 'provider_specialty+network_status']. This addresses the failed correctness checks for missing group metrics by producing per-specialty and per-network-status comparison groups alongside the combined perspective, enabling the task to deliver all required group-level analysis.
